notes: The verse renders two structurally identical construct chains attributively, side by side, each with one supplied the and no article morpheme in the phrase, and places the determiner on opposite members: קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו gave it to the rectum (rule 15) while מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו gave it to the construct (rule 29). Rule 15's noun-of-the-expression sentence governs a numeral and the noun it counts and does not reach a construct chain; rule 29 places the determiners of a chain and licenses a supplied the on the construct noun wherever no article morpheme is present. The chapter's other attributive chains (19.21 בְּתוּלַת -> The virgin, 19.26 יְרַק -> as the green, and מִבְחוֹר here) all follow rule 29, so קוֹמַת is corrected to hold the the.
